content.short: Dragonz Land is a TON card battler where players collect cards, build decks, fight PvP matches, and earn rewards.
content.description: Dragonz Land is a competitive card game on TON built around collecting cards, assembling decks, and battling other players in real time PvP matches. The game includes several card classes such as Heroes, Champions, Spells, and Items, along with progression systems like Trophy Road and seasonal tournaments. Players earn DRAGONZ through wins and achievements, while the broader economy also includes staking and token incentives. It is positioned as a strategy led Web3 game rather than a passive clicker, idle loop, or simple wallet companion.
content.meta: Dragonz Land combines card collection, deck building, PvP battles, and reward earning in a strategy driven TON game experience.
